overall: The AG found the Sandwich School Committee Pool Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by privately deliberating in a hallway during its March 26 meeting, rejecting the claim that no substantive discussion occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the subcommittee improperly met privately in a hallway during its March 26 meeting to discuss a text message about the vendor contract.
allegations.key_passage: Mr. Dever's summary of the text message and related comments, however, does violate the law because it constitutes a communication between the two Subcommittee members that occurred outside of the public's view.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements, applied to any public bodies the School Committee establishes in the future (the Subcommittee itself no longer exists).
Subcommittee members must review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Training Video #1 and certify in writing to this office within 30 days that they reviewed the determination and the video.
remedy_passage: we order the immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements to any public bodies established by the Committee in the future
